t: You're outside Boodle's, the gentlemen's club at 28 St James's Street. It was founded in January 1762 by Lord Shelburne, and it's the second oldest private members' club in London, and in the world. Shelburne later became Prime Minister and then the first Marquess of Lansdowne. He was prime minister in 1782 and 1783, during the final months of the American War of Independence, and he secured peace with America, which remains his most notable legacy. He was also the first home secretary.
